Shopify Plus is basically Shopify’s top-tier plan. It’s built for stores that have simply outgrown the very regular Shopify plans. When it comes to Shopify Plus, you can think of it as Shopify with more power, more automation, and more room to grow.

But “more power” here doesn’t mean that every store needs it right away. Plus costs a lot more than standard Shopify. So the real question isn’t “Is Plus better?” It’s “Does my store actually need what Plus offers?” And “What Shopify Plus benefits are there for me?”

So without wasting a second, let’s start getting all the information about it.

What Shopify Plus Gives You

Here, the main Shopify Plus benefits have been listed, which can set it apart from standard plans:

  • Custom checkout. Plus, it lets you fully customize the checkout experience. Standard plans don’t offer this level of control.
  • Higher traffic capacity. Plus is built to handle big traffic spikes, like flash sales or holiday rushes, without slowing down.
  • More automation. Tools like Shopify Flow let you automate repetitive tasks, from order tagging to inventory alerts.
  • Multiple stores, one login. Plus includes several expansion stores. This helps if you sell in more than one country or run more than one brand.
  • Dedicated support. Plus merchants get faster, more direct help from Shopify’s team.
  • Bigger B2B toolkit. Since April 2026, basic B2B features like company accounts and payment terms are available on every Shopify plan, not just Plus. But Plus still leads here. It offers unlimited pricing catalogs, catalogs assigned directly to specific buyers, and advanced payment controls that other plans don’t have.

Who Actually Needs It?

Plus makes sense once your business hits certain markers, and here’s a simple and easy way to check:

  • Revenue. Most businesses start seeing real value from Plus once they cross $1 million a year in sales. Below that, standard Shopify usually does the job well.
  • Order volume and traffic. If big sales events cause your site to slow down or crash, that’s a strong sign you’ve outgrown standard Shopify.
  • Complex B2B needs. If you manage many customer-specific price lists or need to assign different catalogs to different buyers, Plus handles this better than any other plan.
  • International growth. Selling in three or more countries, each needing its own storefront, currency, and product mix? Plus, this makes it much easier to manage.
  • Custom checkout needs. If your business needs a checkout built around a specific workflow, only Plus gives you that flexibility.

When to Hold Off

If your store is doing well on a standard plan and none of the signals above are applicable to you, then there shouldn’t be any rush at all. Because Plus simply starts at roughly $2,300 a month. That’s a real cost, and it only pays off when your business is ready to use what it offers.

The Simple Rule

Ask yourself: Is my current plan holding my business back, or am I just curious about a bigger platform?

If it’s the first one, like your current plan is holding your business back, then Plus is worth exploring. If it’s the second, standard Shopify may still be the better fit.
